court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Yolo
case_search_note: Court's public case access portal (Tyler). Criminal Division FAQ says it gives summary case details, the court calendar and upcoming hearings; you can also call the Criminal Division at (530) 406-6705 for limited case info (fines, warrants, court date/department). Confidential records (police/probation reports) are not public.

courthouses.name: Yolo Superior Court (Woodland Courthouse)
courthouses.note: The court's only listed location — hears criminal (felony, misdemeanor, non-traffic infractions), traffic (Dept. 2; traffic (530) 406-6702), juvenile ((530) 406-6725), family, civil. In-custody arraignments Mon–Fri 1:30 p.m. in Dept. 1. Calendar kiosk near security on the 1st floor; Criminal Division is on the 1st floor. Department list from the 2026 judicial assignments calendar — assignments change (a 2027 calendar effective 1-4-27 is already posted).

legal_aid.name: Yolo County Public Defender — Record Mitigation & Reintegration Clinic
legal_aid.what: Expungement, felony reductions, early probation termination, certificates of rehabilitation, record sealing (arrests without conviction), sex-offender registry removal. Email is the preferred contact; clinic phone hours Thursdays 1:00–4:00 p.m.

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Woodland Office
legal_aid.serves: Low-income Yolo County residents (civil legal aid)
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid: housing, public benefits, health, education, consumer, unemployment, Social Security, veterans' benefits, elder abuse restraining orders. Office page does not list criminal defense or record clearing. New-applicant intake Mon–Thu 8:30–12 & 1–3 (no new intakes Fridays); evening intake line (866) 815-5990.

probation.name: Yolo County Probation — Main Office
probation.note: Probation's adult FAQ says people granted formal probation must report to the probation office at 2780 E. Gibson Rd., Woodland, right after the hearing (or within 72 hours of release from jail). Alternative Sentencing Office: 2780 E. Gibson Road, Woodland 95776, (530) 669-2331. Fee payments by phone: Yolo County Collections (530) 666-8190. yolocounty.gov blocks automated fetches; pages read in a browser.

programs.name: Addiction Intervention Court (AIC)
programs.summary: Voluntary specialty court (launched 2018) for people whose offenses stem from substance use; up to 20 participants. Four phases (Engagement, Transition, Sustainability, Maintenance) with testing, 12-step or equivalent, employment and housing goals, and a 4–6 week restorative justice component. Graduation requires 9+ months arrest-free and 180+ continuous days sober. Partners: Superior Court, Public Defender, DA, Probation, HHSA. Court calendar lists AIC/MHC/MHD in Dept. 10 (last Friday of the month).
programs.todo: Source is the DA's site (prosecution framing); referral/eligibility criteria not published.

programs.name: Mental Health Court (MHC)
programs.summary: For adults with serious mental illness charged with misdemeanors or felonies; up to 15 participants; minimum 18 months in four phases, ending with a 4–6 week restorative justice component. Partners: Superior Court, Probation, HHSA, Public Defender, DA.

programs.name: Self-Help Center / Family Law Facilitator
programs.summary: 1000 Main Street, 2nd floor, Woodland. Free help for self-represented people (family, small claims, restraining orders, name change, evictions, etc.) — not criminal defense. Walk-in Tue & Thu 8:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; phone Mon/Wed/Fri (530) 406-6793; main (530) 406-6794.

programs.name: Misdemeanor warrant surrender (one-time calendar request)
programs.summary: Per the Criminal Division FAQ, for a misdemeanor warrant you may call (530) 406-6705 to set a one-time 'warrant surrender' court date or turn yourself in. If you miss that date, no further dates are set and the warrant stays outstanding.

jails.name: Monroe Detention Center (MDC)
jails.phone_note: Monroe Records — custody status, charges, bail, court date, housing; also visit scheduling. Sheriff page also lists 530-668-JAIL for MDC.
jails.note: Medium-to-maximum security; primary intake point for everyone booked in Yolo County; 345 beds. In-person non-contact visits daily 1–3 p.m., one 30-min visit/week, book by calling (530) 668-5245 (sign-ups 7 a.m.–midnight the day before). Video visits via ICSolutions. Court: in-custody arraignments Mon–Fri 1:30 p.m., Dept. 1, 1000 Main St. (per court FAQ). Court-ordered report-to-jail: 24-hour lobby by 9:00 a.m.
jails.todo: Sheriff page does not explicitly say men and women are both housed (it says MDC is the intake point for all individuals booked) — 'houses' left null.
